agent_response_tactics.name: Answer direct question first
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent answers the explicit customer question before additional discovery.

agent_response_tactics.name: Acknowledge emotion
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent validates customer emotion signal.

agent_response_tactics.name: Permission-first open
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent asks permission or timing before pitch.

agent_response_tactics.name: Reason-first open
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent states reason for call clearly.

agent_response_tactics.name: Time respectful
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent keeps turn brief and respects timing boundary.

agent_response_tactics.name: Low-pressure boundary
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent removes pressure and keeps optional next step.

agent_response_tactics.name: One relevance point
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent gives one concrete reason this might matter.

agent_response_tactics.name: Simple explanation
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent explains in plain language without jargon.

agent_response_tactics.name: Objection isolation
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent isolates and addresses one main objection.

agent_response_tactics.name: Trust repair
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent acknowledges distrust and clarifies boundaries.

agent_response_tactics.name: Risk reversal
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent reduces perceived risk without guaranteeing outcomes.

agent_response_tactics.name: Safe social proof
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent references credibility without unverifiable claims.

agent_response_tactics.name: Written info offer
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent offers concise written follow-up.

agent_response_tactics.name: Callback offer
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent offers callback window with customer control.

agent_response_tactics.name: Manager review offer
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent offers manager-ready summary or review packet.

agent_response_tactics.name: Handoff to specialist
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent routes to the correct specialist safely.

agent_response_tactics.name: Support boundary route
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent routes support/cancellation issue before sales.

agent_response_tactics.name: Qualify out
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent qualifies out when fit is low.

agent_response_tactics.name: Single discovery question
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent asks one focused discovery question.

agent_response_tactics.name: Proof without unsupported claim
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent gives bounded proof context safely.

agent_response_tactics.name: Payment safety boundary
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent explicitly avoids payment collection on call.

agent_response_tactics.name: Stop after refusal
agent_response_tactics.description: Agent respects refusal and closes cleanly.
